snippet.title: 'The President is enriching himself': CNN panel on Nvidia affair
snippet.description:
President Trump told CNBC that he spoke with Nvidia’s board directly about reinstating CEO Jensen Huang. And he said he assured them there’s no evidence Huang is a national security risk — at least based on what is currently known. Both are extraordinary interventions from the president in the inner workings of an American company. Trump called his actions “very important.”

But financial disclosures show that Trump's investment accounts have bought or sold Nvidia shares at least 103 times between January 2025 and August 2026, meaning that he has likely benefited personally from Nvidia's stock soaring since the board announced that it had reinstated Huang.

snippet.title: GTA 6 - TOPLESS LUCIA NEW Glitch in Free Roam (Any Chapter) | Full Guide (4K PS5 Pro)
snippet.description:
The new GTA 6 TOPLESS LUCIA glitch works in free roam, and the NPCs on Vice City Beach actually react. Some back away, others make comments or turn their heads to stare, and one guy even walks up and tries to flirt with Lucia. I filmed those reactions after triggering the glitch, along with the full setup in 4K on PS5 Pro.

I didn’t see pedestrians react like this with the older Chapter 2 cutscene glitch. This video shows the outfit duplication method I tested in Chapter 3, including what to do if both outfits are checked in the trunk or a long-sleeve shirt shows up in the fitting room.

Full written guide (PS5)
1. Play as Lucia and make a separate manual save. You’ll need her personal car, body armor, a grenade, and the Distressed Trucker Jacket.
2. At home, remove the top under the denim jacket, close the jacket, and save it as a new outfit.
3. In the outfit list, alternate ↑ and ↓ on the D-pad while repeatedly tapping □ to duplicate the outfit. Put both denim outfits in the trunk of Lucia’s personal car.
4. Equip body armor and open the trunk. If both denim outfits are checked and you can’t switch between them, put on the default outfit first, then select one of the denim duplicates. If the vest comes off when you switch to the default, re-equip it before switching back to denim.
5. Check that Lucia is wearing the vest with no top underneath. Go straight to a clothing store fitting room without changing.
6. In the fitting room, delete the saved outfits until only Current Outfit remains, then press △ (Save) once. The saved entry may show a long-sleeve shirt without the vest. Don’t put it on.
7. Duplicate that entry with the same ↑/↓ and □ trick. Don’t equip either copy or put them in the trunk.
8. Back out and leave the store. Lucia should still be wearing the vest with no top underneath. If she’s actually wearing the long-sleeve shirt outside, the setup didn’t stick.
9. In a quiet spot in-game, use a grenade blast to break the vest without killing Lucia. The topless effect only appears once the blast removes the vest. Then head to the beach to see how NPCs react.
Important: This is temporary, not a permanent outfit unlock. The glitch disappears if Lucia dies. Saving and reloading or entering a location that resets her outfit can also remove it. I recorded this in Chapter 3 on PS5 Pro; I didn’t personally test every chapter.

Did it work for you? Comment with your chapter, game version, and the funniest NPC reaction you got.

snippet.title: Ukraine’s 60Patriot Missiles Stuck at Pentagon #russia #ukraine #trump #petehegseth #patriotmissile
snippet.description:
Russia continues to bombard Ukraine with missiles and drones, but around 60 Patriot interceptors allocated to Kyiv are still awaiting approval from US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, according to the Financial Times. The allocation includes around 40 PAC-3 and 20 older PAC-2 missiles, some held in European stockpiles and funded by Ukraine’s allies.

The Pentagon has also reportedly delayed a separate proposal allowing Ukraine to manufacture its own Patriot interceptors. However, it says US policy towards supporting Ukraine has not changed and that cooperation with European partners on Patriot production is continuing.

Meanwhile, the US has approved a proposed $2.1 billion sale of 500 PAC-3 missiles to Ukraine. But deliveries are not expected until the early 2030s. So, while Ukraine needs these interceptors now, a major new supply may still be years away.

The allocation includes around 40 PAC-3 and 20 older PAC-2 missiles, some held in European stockpiles and funded by Ukraine’s allies.

The Pentagon has also reportedly delayed a separate proposal allowing Ukraine to manufacture its own Patriot interceptors. However, it says US policy towards supporting Ukraine has not changed and that cooperation with European partners on Patriot production is continuing.

Meanwhile, the US has approved a proposed $2.1 billion sale of 500 PAC-3 missiles to Ukraine. But deliveries are not expected until the early 2030s. So, while Ukraine needs these interceptors now, a major new supply may still be years away.

snippet.description:
朝の「何食べさせよう…」がひとつ減る🥹🤍

今回は、忙しい朝に助かる「冷凍ミニわかめうどん」を10個まとめて作ってみたよ🍜🧊

子どもの朝ごはんにはもちろん、「ちょっとだけ食べたいな」ってときにも便利♡

豆腐の空きパックを使って小分けにしておけば、食べたいときに必要な分だけ取り出せるよ☺️

週末にまとめて冷凍しておくだけで、朝ごはんの準備がちょっとラクになるのがうれしい☀️

🍳【材料・ミニうどん10個分】

・ゆでうどん…3食分
・乾燥わかめ…大さじ1
・かまぼこ…適量
・ネギ…適量

油揚げやお好みの野菜を足してもOK🙆‍♀️

👩🏻‍🍳【作り方】

① うどんを水でほぐして、表面のぬめりを取る。

② きれいに洗って乾かした豆腐の空きパックに、好きな具材を入れる。

③ うどんを10等分して、それぞれのパックに入れる。

④ ラップでしっかり包んで冷凍したら、ストックの完成🧊✨

🥣【食べるとき】

冷凍したミニうどんを耐熱容器に移して、

・水…150ml
・めんつゆ、または白だし…大さじ1

を加え、電子レンジ600Wで2〜3分を目安に温めるだけ！

※加熱時間は目安なので、中心までしっかり温まっているか確認してね。足りない場合は追加で加熱してね。

※豆腐の空きパックは小分け用の型として使い、電子レンジでは使用しないでください。

冷凍庫にこれがあるだけで、朝の「何食べさせよう…」がひとつ減るのが本当に助かる🥹🤍

忙しい朝にも、少しだけ温かいうどんが食べたいときにもぴったりだよ🍜

「これなら作れそう！」と思ったら、忘れないように保存してね📌

週末にまとめて作って、平日の朝を少しラクにしよう🫶

みんなは朝ごはんに何を冷凍ストックしてる？☺️

ぜひコメントで教えてね♡

いいね・チャンネル登録もしてもらえたらうれしいです🤍

As Christmas approaches, Miles struggles with the difference between their worlds, the judgment of others, and his fear of being hurt again. Elena wants something her successful career has never guaranteed: someone who chooses her for who she really is.

snippet.title: La Vida Real en LONDRES: Récord de Personas Durmiendo en la Calle Junto al Palacio de Buckingham
snippet.description:
La Vida Real en LONDRES: Récord de Personas Durmiendo en la Calle Junto al Palacio de Buckingham
Descubre la impactante vida real en LONDRES, una de las ciudades más ricas del mundo, donde miles de personas duermen en las calles, incluso cerca del Palacio de Buckingham. En este documental de DIS Global ES, exploramos la crisis de las personas sin hogar, las familias que viven en hoteles temporales, los alquileres exorbitantes y los pequeños apartamentos donde muchos apenas pueden sobrevivir. Desde las lujosas mansiones de Mayfair y Knightsbridge hasta los barrios más pobres, los mercados caóticos de Camden y la vida nocturna de Soho, conocerás el lado oculto de Londres que pocos turistas llegan a ver. ¿Cómo puede existir tanta pobreza y desigualdad en una ciudad llena de riqueza y lujo?
